info.title: Urja Meter API
info.description:
A clean, documented REST API over the **Urja Meter Ops** portal (which has no API of its own).

* **Meters** – inventory with filtering, search, proximity and bounding-box queries.
* **Readings** – cleaned interval readings with derived consumption, or daily roll-ups.
* **Network** – the meter hierarchy (Zone › Circle › Division › Subdivision › Substation › Feeder › DT),
  reconstructed and repaired from per-meter records.
* **Insights** – data-quality report and fleet anomalies the portal can't show.

All timestamps are ISO 8601 in IST (+05:30). Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
If the server sets `URJA_API_KEYS`, send one in the `X-API-Key` header.

get.summary: Energy readings and consumption for a meter
get.description: Returns cleaned interval readings (`granularity=raw`) or per-day consumption (`granularity=daily`) for an inclusive date range in IST. The portal stores cumulative registers; this endpoint also derives per-interval consumption. With no dates, returns the 7 days ending at the meter's latest reading (matching the portal's default). Results are cached; see `meta.cache`.

completeness.title: Completeness
completeness.description: intervals / expected intervals for the meter's cadence (1.0 = complete day).

code_reuse.title: Code Reuse
code_reuse.description: Codes that appear under more than one parent (why node ids are path-scoped).

synced_at.title: Synced At
synced_at.description: When the inventory snapshot was taken from the portal (IST).

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True if the snapshot is older than twice the refresh interval (e.g. portal down).

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: How many meters have cached readings; insights only cover those.

daily_fleet_kwh.title: Daily Fleet Kwh
daily_fleet_kwh.description: Sum over covered meters only; compare with coverage before reading trends.

consumption_histogram.title: Consumption Histogram
consumption_histogram.description: Meters per 2 kWh/day bin of average daily consumption.

record_format.title: Record Format
record_format.description: Which portal record format the meter uses ('legacy' or 'v2').

data_quality.title: Data Quality
data_quality.description: Repairs or inconsistencies found in the portal's record for this meter.

id.title: Id
id.description: Path-scoped node id, unique across the network (codes alone are not).

alias.title: Alias
alias.description: Alternative name seen on some meter records (transformers only).

kwh.title: Kwh
kwh.description: Consumption since the previous reading (kWh). Null for the first reading or if the register went backwards.

interval_start.title: Interval Start
interval_start.description: Start of the interval this row's kWh covers.

cleaning.title: Cleaning
cleaning.description: What was cleaned on this fetch (duplicates merged, blanks, ...).

cadence_minutes.title: Cadence Minutes
cadence_minutes.description: 30 for AMI half-hourly meters, 1440 for daily reads.

network.title: Network
network.description: Upstream chain (zone … feeder) for this transformer.
